title: Boundary-Explicit Fossil-Free System Study
research_question: Under what combinations of generation, electrification, storage, networks, flexible demand, non-fossil molecules, and feedstocks can a region eliminate fossil extraction and combustion while meeting hourly reliability, energy-service, affordability, access, lifecycle, land, water, mineral, and governance constraints?

stages.name: baseline_and_boundary_audit
stages.purpose: Build hourly service ledger and identify hidden fossil uses.

stages.name: technology_and_lifecycle_characterization
stages.purpose: Parameterize performance, lifetime, resource, replacement, and upstream burdens.

stages.name: hourly_and_seasonal_optimization
stages.purpose: Optimize generation, storage, networks, fuels, and sector coupling under operating constraints.

stages.name: stress_testing_and_robustness
stages.purpose: Test correlated weather, outage, supply-chain, and demand stresses.

stages.name: infrastructure_adoption_and_distribution
stages.purpose: Constrain build rates and evaluate access, burden, financing, and lead times.

stages.name: out_of_sample_validation_and_decision
stages.purpose: Validate held-out conditions and identify regional binding constraints.

safeguards: declare fossil-free boundary and keep net-zero-with-CCS separate
screen water land mineral and recycling constraints
review hydrogen ammonia bioenergy carbon capture nuclear and grid safety
do not represent modeled results as observed facts
